err.flow.curve.param: Engine error message; {name} = parameter name, {value} = value written.
err.flow.curve.role: Engine error message; {role} = role written in the standards file.
err.flow.curve.row: Engine error message; {file} = responses or standards, {detail} = row and technical detail.
err.flow.quant.curveRow: Engine error message; {detail} = row and technical detail.
err.flow.quant.kind: Engine error message; {kind} = calibration type written in the file.
err.flow.rtpredict.standards: Engine error message; {n} = readable standards, {min} = required minimum.
err.flow.param.axis: Flow engine error: an m/z tolerance is written in the unit of the other axis. {param} = parameter name, {axis} = file axis (Da = unit resolution, ppm = high resolution).
err.flow.align.polarity: Flow engine error: the alignment receives files of different polarities. {positive}, {negative} = names of the positive and negative files, separated by commas.
err.flow.align.resolution: Flow engine error: the alignment receives unit-resolution and high-resolution files. {unit}, {high} = names of the files of the two groups, separated by commas.
err.flow.io: {detail} = path and reason from the operating system (English text).
err.flow.check: Engine error message; {count} = number, {instance} = step name.
err.flow.group.ion: Engine error message; {ion} = name of the ion species written in the plan (e.g. [M+Na]+).
err.flow.instance.id: Engine error message; {instance} = name of the step rejected because it becomes a file name.
err.flow.massacc.references: Engine error message; {line} = line number, {message} = message.
err.flow.param.type: Engine error message; {detail} = technical detail, {instance} = step name, {param} = parameter name.
err.flow.param.unknown: Engine error message; {instance} = step name, {param} = parameter name.
err.flow.port.format: Flow check error message; {ref} = source (file or instance.port), {writes} = format it writes (mzfeat, csv, filtri/1, ...), {reads} = formats the input reads, separated by « / ».
err.flow.port.unwritten: Flow check error message; {ref} = output (instance.port), {input} = input to connect, {param} = setting that excludes it (name=value).
err.flow.ref: Engine error message; {instance} = step name, {port} = input, {ref} = link.
err.flow.screen.mzsus: Engine error message; {file} = file name, {reason} = reason.
err.flow.step: Engine error message; {instance} = step name, {step} = step.
err.flow.step.version: Engine error message; {available} = available version, {step} = step, {version} = version.
err.flow.type: Engine error message; {from} = source type, {to} = target type.
